chunks: If it is said: What is the way of finding the truth during the occultation of the Imam?
If you say that there is no way, you have led people to confusion, misguidance and doubt in all their affairs;
and if you say that the truth is found through its proofs, you will be told that this is a clear admission of lack of need of the Imam through these proofs.
ai.seo_question: How can Muslims find religious truth during the occultation of the Imam?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi uses this dialectical argument to address the epistemological crisis of the Minor and Major Occultation, challenging the notion that divine guidance ceases with the Imam's physical absence. He posits that while the Imam remains the ultimate source of infallible authority, the 'adillah' (proofs) of God—primarily the Quran and the Sunnah—remain sufficient for discerning truth, thereby preventing humanity from falling into total confusion (hira) without implying the Imam's total irrelevance.
